paddle.label: Bidder {number}
paddle.maxInvalid: Enter a plain amount such as 250 or 99.50.

bidPanel.title: Confirm bid
bidPanel.meetsLimit: This bid reaches the minimum price. If it wins, the card is yours.
bidPanel.belowLimit: This bid is {amount} below the minimum price. A lot that stays below it is not sold.
bidPanel.noLimit: This lot has no minimum price. The highest bid wins.
bidPanel.binding: This bid is binding. If you win, you owe {amount} in USDC and must sign the payment in time.
bidPanel.outcome: The card moves to your wallet and the seller is paid in the same transaction. Hammerprice never holds either.
bidPanel.demoNote: Bidding in this room is a demonstration: no signature, no transaction, nothing charged.
bidPanel.ifYouWin: If you win you pay {amount} and the card moves to your wallet.
bidPanel.fromLink: The amount comes from your Telegram link. Nothing is placed until you confirm and sign in your own wallet.
bidPanel.fromLinkAdjusted: The amount in your link no longer fits, so the current next bid is shown. Nothing is placed until you confirm and sign in your own wallet.

fees.heading: What happens if you win
fees.commission: Hammerprice keeps {pct}% of the sale price ({amount}), charged to the seller. As a bidder you pay your bid and nothing else.
fees.approx: SOL amounts are approximate at the current rate. You pay in USDC.

bid.bindingLabel: Place binding bid, payment due if you win
bid.noPaddleOpen: Bidding is open. Get your bidder number to join.
bid.noPaddleSoon: Bidding opens soon. You can get your bidder number now.
bid.balanceLow: Your balance is below this bid.
bid.pendingServer: Waiting for the room to confirm…

wallet.title: Connect a wallet to bid
wallet.needWallet: A Solana wallet. It holds your USDC and signs your bids.
wallet.needUsdc: USDC to pay if you win.
wallet.mobileBody: Open this page inside your wallet's own browser, then connect.
wallet.guestTitle: No wallet? Try the practice room
wallet.guestBody: Bid against simulated bidders. No wallet needed, nothing is sent.

practice.more: What is real and what is simulated?
practice.title: Practice room
practice.real: Real: the cards, their grades, and the minimum price and bid step rules.
practice.simulated: Simulated: the bidders, their bids and the clock. Nothing is signed, sent or charged.
practice.link: See what is built and what is not

devnet.title: Solana devnet
devnet.body: This room settles on Solana devnet. Your wallet must be on devnet too, or it cannot sign.
devnet.step2: Phantom: Settings, Developer Settings, turn on Testnet Mode, then choose Solana Devnet. Solflare and Backpack: switch the network to Devnet in settings.
devnet.step3: Come back and reload this page.

errors.network: Could not reach Hammerprice. Check your connection and try again.
errors.noSignMessage: This wallet cannot sign messages. Use Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.
errors.walletRejected: You cancelled the signature in your wallet.
errors.walletCluster: Your wallet could not sign. It is probably on the wrong network: open Details at the top of the page.
errors.walletUnsupported: This wallet cannot sign messages. Use Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.
errors.walletUnknown: Your wallet could not sign. Try again.
errors.walletNotConnected: The wallet is not connected yet. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.walletTimeout: Your wallet did not answer in time. Open the wallet, check the request and try again.
errors.validation: That request was not valid. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: You are signed out. Verify your wallet again to bid.
errors.bad_signature: Your wallet's signature did not check out. Try again.
errors.replay: That bid was already sent. Check the feed before trying again.
errors.banned: This wallet is banned from bidding.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.not_found: This lot or show no longer exists.
errors.wrong_state: The room does not allow that right now.
errors.nonce_used: That verification was already used. Verify your wallet again.
errors.expired: Your verification expired. Verify your wallet again.
errors.wrong_domain: The wallet signed a message for another site. Reload and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} s and try again.
errors.paused: Bidding is paused for now. Try again shortly.
errors.balance_unavailable: We could not read your USDC balance. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.rpc_unavailable: The Solana network is slow to answer. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.insufficient_funds: Your available USDC does not cover this bid. Add USDC to your wallet or bid less.
errors.lot_not_open: This lot is not open for bids.
errors.lot_closed: This lot just closed. Your bid was not accepted.
errors.bid_too_low: Someone bid first. The lowest bid now is {amount}.
errors.amount_too_large: That amount is above the largest bid allowed.
errors.self_bid: You cannot bid on your own lot.
errors.already_high_bidder: You already hold the high bid.
errors.no_paddle: Finish getting ready to bid first.
errors.paddle_limit: That is above the spending limit you set for this room. Raise the limit under "Advanced options" in "Get ready to bid", or bid a lower amount.
errors.mainnet_config_incomplete: This site is not fully set up for real payments yet. Nothing was sent.
errors.cluster_config_conflict: The network settings of this site contradict each other. Nothing was sent.
errors.show_paused: The seller paused the room. Bidding resumes with the same time left. Your bid was not placed.

feed.title: Room
feed.empty: Quiet so far, nothing bid yet. Bids and chat land here.
feed.note: Chat is local to your screen only.

feed.extended: Lot {number}: a late bid added time

feed.notCompleted: Lot {number}: not completed, the time ran out
feed.houseWon: Lot {number}: a house bot won. No sale, the card stays with the house

win.title: You won
win.outcome: Once you pay, the card moves to your wallet and the seller is paid in the same step. Hammerprice holds neither.

status.awaiting: Payment due. Confirm it in your wallet to finish the purchase.
status.submitted: Both sides confirmed. Finishing on the network…
status.settled: Paid. The card is in your wallet.
status.windowEnded: The payment window has ended. Paying is no longer possible and the sale will be recorded as not completed.
status.lapsed: Not completed, the time ran out.

win.practiceNote: This was the practice room: nothing was signed, transferred or charged. On a live lot, the seller is paid in USDC and the card moves to the winner's wallet in one transaction.

demoOutcome.wonBody: This was a demo run with a replica card. In a real room, the card you just won would be yours.
demoOutcome.outbidTitle: You were outbid in this demo.
demoOutcome.outbidBody: This was a demo run with a replica card. In a real room, the card shown here would go to the winner.

desk.title: A payment is waiting for you
desk.buyer: You won this lot. Pay to finish the purchase.
desk.seller: You sold this lot. Confirm to hand over the card.

connect.body: Choose the wallet that will hold your card and your USDC.
connect.watch: You can watch the room without a wallet. You only need one to bid.

verify.body: Your wallet signs a short message to show that it is yours. This is free and sends no money.

funds.bodyDevnet: Your wallet does not hold enough USDC yet. Fill it here with free devnet test USDC to try bidding.
funds.bodyMain: Add at least $1 in USDC to this wallet, then check again.
funds.limited: You claimed test USDC recently, so you cannot claim again for now. Try again later.
funds.paused: Claiming test USDC is paused right now. Try again later.
funds.failed: We could not send test USDC. Try again.

start.body: One last free signature gives you your bidding number. After that you can bid without a wallet pop-up each time.

advanced.limitHelp: Your bidding number cannot bid above this. Default: your balance, at most $250 (now {amount}).
